taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii subsp. ultramontana (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): shrubs usually 10-30 dm (to 50).

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii subsp. ultramontana (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): to 50 dm.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): shrubs forming thickets or more or less open stands.

traits.spine_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii subsp. ultramontana (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): prickles below the stipules usually erect, 2-7 mm; few between the nodes.

traits.bark_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): bark dark red; sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets green and dull above, pale green beneath; sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves 2.5-8 (to 12) cm.

traits.leaflets.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets 5-7 (to 9).

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet blade 12-35 mm long (6-40); 20-32 mm in subsp. ultramontana.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet blade 6-20 (to 26) mm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet blades obovate, elliptic or ovate, usually widest at or above the middle.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet apex acute or obtuse.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet margins singly serrate, 7-14 teeth a side on the outer half.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): usually panicles, sometimes corymbs or single flowers; drawn as a corymb, as the few-flowered clusters of subsp. ultramontana read.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii subsp. ultramontana (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences (1-)3-10 (to 25)-flowered.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: flower clusters 4 cm to 10 cm long.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicels erect, slender, 10-20 (to 33) mm.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers 3-3.5 cm across (2-5).

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals 15-20 (to 25) mm.

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals spreading, 8-15 (to 21) mm.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals pink to deep rose; sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens about 65.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): carpels 20-40 (16-50).

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips 6-13 (to 16) mm long.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips 5-12 (to 15) mm wide.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips globose to ovoid, most often globose.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): hips red, orange-red or purplish red; sRGB by eye for red.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals persistent on the hip, erect to spreading.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Rosa woodsii subsp. ultramontana (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering May to July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: hips ripe from August, held into late autumn.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: an open thicket of dark-red stems with small dull leaflets, clusters of pink roses at the tips of the side branches, and small round red hips crowned by their sepals.

allometry.note: 2.8 m tall at 12 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
